title: 经营财务分析
scope: Business financial statements, budget variance, cash-flow scenarios and assumption-sensitive valuation reviews.
routingDescription: Business financial statements, budget variance, cash-flow scenarios and assumption-sensitive valuation reviews.
useWhen: Explain a budget variance or cash-runway discrepancy
Review a business forecast or valuation assumptions

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use causal inference when attributing financial change to a specific intervention.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Confirm currency, period, entity scope, units and cash versus accrual basis.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Reconcile definitions before attributing a variance.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Check completeness and reconcile income, balance-sheet and cash-flow relationships using available evidence.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Do not infer liquidity from accounting profit alone.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Separate price, volume, mix, timing and one-off effects where data supports the distinction.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Label unsupported causal explanations as hypotheses.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Expose revenue/cost assumptions, discount and terminal assumptions, and their sensitivity.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Present a range and decision-sensitive assumptions rather than a precise unsupported valuation.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Choose materiality and comparison benchmarks appropriate to the business and decision.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Avoid applying generic ratio targets or current market inputs without a verified source.

evidenceRequirements: Financial basis, period, currency and scope
Available statements or driver-level actual/budget data
Forecast assumptions, sensitivity and source dates
qualityChecks: Separate profit, cash and enterprise/equity values
No personalized investment recommendation or compliance certification
riskRules: Material financial commitments and regulated advice need accountable professional review

preferredSources: Entity financial statements and accounting-policy notes for the stated period
Official applicable accounting standards and dated verified market inputs
refreshTriggers: Current market inputs, accounting rules and jurisdiction-specific requirements
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: A profitable company has a shorter runway after receivables doubled.
examples.expected: Reconcile cash collection, working capital and the forecast basis.
examples.reject: Infer that reported profit guarantees adequate cash runway.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
